      "observations": [
        "All 1,035 owned diff lines and all changed tests across 13 paths were read. The new format is opt-in: the shipped preference remains multipart. Only signed-only PGP/MIME with the exact unobtrusive preference adds SEND_SIG_UNOBTRUSIVE and signFormat; encrypted modes remain on their existing structure path.",
        "The shared nsIMsgComposeSecure interface gains AUTF8String signFormat, and the S/MIME class implements storage/accessors to satisfy it. MimeMessage consumes the property when choosing payload header parameters. Those accessors alone do not establish an S/MIME unobtrusive-format implementation.",
        "The writer uses a multipart/mixed wrapper and a folded Sig: t=p; b= field instead of a detached signature attachment. It validates minimum armored-output shape, removes the declared framing/checksum positions with slice/join, and emits the signed buffer afterward. These shape checks are not a complete armor parser or fresh signature verification.",
        "Canonicalization changes only trailing CRLF sequences: it adds one when absent, retains one for signing when multiple exist, and saves the extras in cryptoIrrelevantMessageSuffix for later emission. The comment states the exact one-CRLF constraint and the saved value's purpose. A rejected endsWith/includes rewrite is not treated as adopted.",
        "MimeMessage predicts plain/HTML output before building parts so hp=clear lands on the payload's actual top Content-Type: a leaf, related, alternative or mixed container. Crypto wrapping moves multiple child parts down one level and carries hp on the new payload container. Optional MimeMultiPart ctparams keeps other constructor calls valid. The paired predictor and builder remain a scoped equivalence contract, not a new global API rule.",
        "The new registered browser test covers eight sequential plain/bold and Auto/PlainText/HTML/Both output-shape cases and checks hp on the first subpart; the normal-send helper checks absence of hp. Both added hp assertions lack messages. Other new assertions have explicit expected-state strings; missing should alone is not reported as a defect. A 500 ms copied delay and preference set/clear exist historically; accepted setup instead uses pushPrefEnv and later pacing changes, without proving the original test ran.",
        "Fixed accepted code retains the generation algorithm and MIME placement. Later clean-body encoding and receiving/processing changes remain separate phases. Exact current writer and interface objects already inspected for 4741/4746 are reused whole, with original timestamps, without a new independent confirmation.",
        "The initial preference comment leaves the quote after unobtrusive unclosed; the literal preference value remains unambiguous. The new paramsForTop/ctparams docs name their specific header roles, and local named send flags preserve the distinction between signing and encryption. No unrelated comment/style rewrite is proposed.",
        "Complete primary Bug 1958983 covers generation, a first landing and later processing work D274770/dbee5a3fd41e. This owned comm patch generates signatures; the later receiving phase, IETF discussion and draft adoption remain bounded unread context.",
        "Complete D244674 includes 22 actual inline bodies, the actual native old/new code-only suggestion and five literal code blocks. The manual merge D272163 complaint is a historical author report, not a reproduced source failure or an inspected dependency.",
        "The reviewer proposes endsWith/includes canonicalization; the author rejects it as nonequivalent and retains a regex-based solution with a clearer constraint comment. A slice/join proposal is adopted with added trim and armor-shape checks. Removal of the gossip guard is rejected because a supplied value can be undefined; the source retains nullish fallback rather than assuming a string.",

The classic test historically sets multipart and clears its preference; the new test selects unobtrusive. Accepted pushPrefEnv and later test changes are not back-projected into this first landing.",
